purpose: Machine-readable inputs required to redraw quantitative Figure 2

files.name: 01_canonical_primary_grid_1080.csv
files.role: Reproduces the original six-point canonical grid

files.name: 02_canonical_extended_grid_1620.csv
files.role: Recommended source for the revised Fig. 2c because it resolves sub-0.5-min boundaries

files.name: 03_canonical_waveform_register.csv
files.role: Exact mathematical definitions of pulse, ramp, sinusoid, T, and parameter grids

files.name: 04_representative_model_traces.csv
files.role: Real C_in, C_f, and S traces for Fig. 2b at T=30 min, tau_f=5 min, tau_s=1 min

files.name: 05_empirical_waveforms_model_inputs.csv
files.role: The seven exact resampled traces passed to the empirical models

files.name: 06_empirical_waveforms_raw_digitized_points.csv
files.role: Raw public-figure digitization points for the four Saha and three Choi traces

files.name: 07_empirical_stress_test_full_1295.csv
files.role: All continuous, event-reset, and chronological empirical runs

files.name: 09_empirical_operating_envelope.csv
files.role: Precomputed strict and relaxed contiguous envelopes

files.name: 10_digitization_manifest.csv
files.role: Figure panel and pixel-to-axis calibration provenance

guardrails: Use the extended 1,620-row grid for the revised Fig. 2c.
Treat Saha and Choi traces as already filtered device outputs.
Do not interpret assigned model thresholds as clinical acceptance limits.
Do not replace failed-at-minimum conditions with numerical zero values.
